healthy.Text: Uhm, are you sure it is as healthy as it is tasty?

Text: This drink is just awesome. I love it!

{delay 3}Everything about it. This fizz-sound when I open it. The pressure beneath the tongue when I drink it. The slight sting in the throat when I swallow the bubbly stuff. If I only knew how they make it!

healthy.Text: You're worried about my weight are you? Haha, don't worry, I'll be fine. Cardiac arrests are a thing of the past you know. Nanotechnology will keep me alive regardless of how many sodas I scoff down, with all those tiny machines cleaning up my arteries. And if I feel a little dodgy; a short trip to the next surgery clinic with a fresh Stamina chest implant and woosh! I am as good as gold! Life is all about excesses and pleasures!
